tools.name: genmc_status
tools.description: Show whether you are paired with a genMC studio tab, whether it is reachable, which studio page it shows and which tools it offers. Call it when studio tools are missing from your tool list (the user switched studios): its answer also brings your tool list up to date.

tools.name: genmc_call
tools.description: Call any tool of the paired studio tab by name. Use it when your tool list has not refreshed after pairing or after the user switched studios; otherwise call the tool directly.

tools.description: Search and read the genMC knowledge base: how every studio, tool, button, limit and workflow works (skins, builds, agents and pairing, accounts and sharing, export, shortcuts, troubleshooting). findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "genmc_pair" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "genmc_pair" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
